Generate random NPIs

Source: R/generate.R
generate.Rd

Creates an integer vector of random NPIs.

Usage

generate(n = 10L, prop = 0.1, syntactic = TRUE, valid = FALSE)

Arguments

n

<integer>, default is 10; number of NPIs to generate

prop

<double>, between 0 and 1, default is 0.1; proportion of NAs to insert

syntactic

<boolean>, default is TRUE; syntactically valid output

valid

<boolean>, default is FALSE; technically valid output

Value

A vector of random NPIs

Examples

generate()
#>  [1] 1645358447 1164415312 1856458594 1103750512 1081470292 1169253906
#>  [7] 1552817006 1589156954 1620405001 1460366717
generate(n = 100, prop = 0.2, syntactic = FALSE)
